sections.Profile:
"Quartette" and "Four Stars," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1952, are very similar electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Good Times, Dual Theme, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
